description: This file implements utility functions for command handling in the Cuttlefish project, including reading/writing binary data over sockets, managing launcher actions, and connecting to launcher monitors.

classes.name: LauncherActionInfo
classes.description: Structure holding launcher action and optional extended action data.

classes.name: ExtendedLauncherAction
classes.description: Protobuf message for extended launcher actions.

classes.name: LauncherResponse
classes.description: Enum representing responses from launcher actions.

methods.name: IsShortAction
methods.description: Determines if a launcher action is considered short and simple.

methods.name: WriteAllBinaryResult
methods.description: Writes binary data to a file descriptor, ensuring complete transmission.

methods.name: ReadExactBinaryResult
methods.description: Reads exact binary data from a file descriptor, handling EOF and errors.

methods.name: ReadExitCode
methods.description: Reads the exit code from a monitor socket.

methods.name: GetLauncherMonitorFromInstance
methods.description: Connects to a launcher monitor socket for a specific instance.

methods.name: GetLauncherMonitor
methods.description: Gets the launcher monitor socket for a given configuration and instance number.

methods.name: ReadLauncherActionFromFd
methods.description: Reads a launcher action, possibly with extended data, from a socket.

methods.name: WaitForRead
methods.description: Waits for data to be available on a socket with a timeout.

methods.name: RunLauncherAction
methods.description: Sends a launcher action to a socket and waits for a success response.

methods.name: RunLauncherAction (overload)
methods.description: Sends an extended launcher action to a socket and waits for a success response.
